historical_reference_only.identity: Original Foundation-V2 historical frozen reference; missing adapter is not recovered.

fixed_nonfinal_selection_surfaces.capability_direction: frozen subset of the existing Foundation-V2 capability diagnostic, with its episode IDs, generator seeds, and hashes frozen in the reconstruction launch manifest before model load

hard_preconditions: Mounted input identity preflight passes every required base, tokenizer, dataset, replay, schedule, recipe, source-commit, and budget check.
All gate predictions and scores are generated before reading or reporting the exposed Novel holdout.
No gate tolerances, datasets, seeds, or selection rules change after training begins.

require_all: macro_family_loss < frozen base score on the identical sentinel
novel_teacher_forced.rationale: Requires a substantial recovery of the historical 0.0616404971 Novel validation loss without requiring byte-identical stochastic optimization.

require_all: macro_family_loss < frozen base score on the identical sentinel
replay_teacher_forced.rationale: Requires strong replay retention against the historical 0.0497418183 macro loss.

require_all: both macro exact rates exceed the frozen base rate on their identical generation surface
generation.rationale: Requires generation-level improvement consistent with, but not numerically identical to, historical 0.8828125 Novel and 0.84375 replay exact accuracy.

require_all: no protected family exact-rate decrease exceeds 0.125
no protected ontology section has an exact-rate decrease exceeding 0.10
protected_retention.rationale: Rejects broad or important degradation while treating isolated one-observation changes conservatively.

require_all: at least 20 of the 25 frozen historically improved capabilities are non-declining versus Base on the fixed direction subset
no more than 2 capabilities decline by more than 0.125 versus Base on that subset
at least 28 of the frozen 36 STRONG-or-SATURATED capabilities remain at or above 0.75 on their fixed direction subset
capability_direction.rationale: Requires broadly compatible direction, not a claim of exact Foundation-V2 equivalence.

checkpoint_evaluation_plan.direction_subset_timing: Run only for checkpoints that meet all other hard metrics; never use exposed holdout for selection.
checkpoint_evaluation_plan.selection_rule: If tokens_2000000 meets every hard metric, select it. Otherwise, among checkpoints meeting every hard metric, select lowest Novel macro-family loss, break ties by lowest replay macro-family loss, then highest Novel generation macro exact.

outcome_rules.EQUIVALENCE_CONFIRMED: A selected checkpoint meets every hard metric. It is a new RECONSTRUCTED_FOUNDATION_V2_V1 identity and may be considered for TARGETED_CAPABILITY_REPAIR_V1R.
outcome_rules.EQUIVALENCE_PARTIAL: Novel broad gain is recovered but one or more replay, generation, protected retention, or capability-direction hard metric fails. Preserve evidence and escalate; targeted repair is forbidden.
outcome_rules.EQUIVALENCE_FAILED: No checkpoint satisfies Novel recovery or identity/validity preconditions. Preserve evidence and escalate; targeted repair is forbidden.

exposed_holdout_rule: The 200-episode Novel holdout is report-only after a checkpoint has been selected through this gate. It never selects, rejects, tunes, or authorizes reconstruction or targeted repair.
